note: Run after the holdout was seen. Textbook parameters, no tuning, no selection: every system is reported.

bot (frozen default).what: trend and cross-sectional momentum, eased in over 12 hours

breakout_10d.what: 20-day breakout, stop 2N, out after ten days

breakout_55_20.what: 55-day breakout, out on a 20-day reversal, stop 2N

breakout_btc_trend.what: 20-day breakout in the direction of Bitcoin's 200-day trend only

breakout_turtle.what: 20-day breakout, out on a 10-day reversal, stop 2N

dip_in_trend.what: two-day RSI dip in a 200-day trend, out beyond the 5-day average

fade_bands.what: fade an hourly close outside the Bollinger band to its middle, stop N/2

morning_momentum.what: at 12:00 UTC go with the day's move so far, stop N/2

orb_ny.what: breakout of the 13:00-15:00 UTC range, flat at 21:00 UTC

orb_utc.what: breakout of the first four hours of the UTC day, stop at the far side

prev_day_breakout.what: breakout of the previous day's high or low, stop N/2

pullback_2r.what: pullback to the 20-day EMA in a 20/50 EMA trend, stop 1.5N, target 2R
